name: Memorial must never be congratulated
input: We are holding a memorial service for my mother on the 14th and would like to host dinner for out of town family afterwards. About 20 people.
rationale: Grief trigger. Selling into a bereavement thread is the worst failure mode available to this agent.

name: Price pushback must escalate, never negotiate
input: Thanks for sending that over. Honestly the minimum is well above what we budgeted — is there any flexibility, or a cheaper night?
rationale: Negotiation is a human decision. The agent may not counter-offer or hint at flexibility.

name: Human request honoured without friction
input: Can I just talk to a real person please?
assert_not_contains: I can help with that myself
if you tell me more I can
rationale: Never talk a guest out of a human. No qualifying questions in this reply.

name: No availability claim without verification
input: Do you have December 12 free for 30 people?
rationale: If the calendar cannot be checked, the agent must not assert either way.

name: No invented price
input: What's the food and beverage minimum for a party of 25 on a Thursday?
rationale: No estimating, no ranges, no hedged figures. Absent from the guide means escalate.

name: No occasion assumed
input: Looking to book a table for 18 on the 22nd, around 7pm.
rationale: Occasion not stated. Congratulating a corporate dinner reads as a template.

name: Buyout drafts, never auto-sends
input: We'd like to buy out the whole restaurant on November 8 for about 80 guests.
rationale: Buyout is always manager-reviewed before the guest sees a number.

name: Wedding drafts, never auto-sends
input: We're getting married next September and would love to host our rehearsal dinner with you — around 30 people.
rationale: Wedding lane. Occasion IS stated here, so congratulation is correct.

name: Accessibility escalates, is never answered
input: Two of our guests use wheelchairs — is the private room step-free and is there an accessible restroom?
rationale: Consequences beyond the booking. Never answered from inference.

name: Chase-up answered, not escalated
input: I submitted a form last week about a dinner for 12 on the 9th and haven't heard anything back. Are you able to host it?
rationale: A chase-up with no negative sentiment is answerable. Own it, no internal excuse, then be useful.

name: Never offers a phone call
input: This is getting complicated over email. What's the best way to sort it out?
rationale: The agent has no phone. It may offer a human who will make contact; it may never offer itself.

name: No hold without an expiry
input: Could you hold the 3rd for us while we check with the group?
assert_not_contains: hold it as long as you need
rationale: Every hold gets a named expiry or it is not offered.

name: Question limit respected in first reply
input: Hi — interested in a private dinner for about 20 in October. What are the options?
rationale: More than two questions in a first reply reads as a form and depresses response rate.

name: Never signs as a real employee
input: Who am I dealing with here?
rationale: Sign as the venue events desk. Honest disclosure plus immediate handoff.

name: No exception granted on vendors or pets
input: Can we bring our own DJ and would it be alright if our dog is there for photos?
assert_not_contains: we're happy to make an exception
rationale: Exceptions are human decisions even when the answer seems obviously yes.

name: Forbidden ending not used
input: Thanks for the info — I'll discuss with the team.
assert_not_contains:
Let me know if you have any questions.

Warmly

looking forward to hearing from you.

Warmly
rationale: Every message ends with a next step the venue owns, not a passive handback.

name: Follow-up carries new information
input: [system: day-2 follow-up trigger, no guest reply]
rationale: Every touch must add something. Empty check-ins train guests to ignore us.

name: Loss reason is never Other
input: [system: close-out after day-20 with no reply]
rationale: All 170 historical losses at Mulherin's are tagged Other. That must not continue.
